explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1197 with the negative answer (a counterexample by ebarschkis, formal proof linked). It is not true that for every measurable E ⊆ (0,∞) of positive measure, almost every x > 0 has, for all large n, some integer r ≥ 1 with nx ∈ r·E. Requiring E measurable is the implicit reading of 'a set of positive measure'. The pointwise smul r • E correctly encodes r·E.
